name: io.github.opsrev/acculynx
description: AccuLynx MCP server — use the AccuLynx roofing CRM in Claude Desktop, Cursor, and any MCP client.

environmentVariables.name: ACCULYNX_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: AccuLynx official API key (Account Settings -> API).

environmentVariables.name: ACCULYNX_EMAIL
environmentVariables.description: AccuLynx login email. Only needed for web-API tools.

environmentVariables.name: ACCULYNX_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: AccuLynx login password. Only needed for web-API tools.

environmentVariables.name: ACCULYNX_COMPANY_ID
environmentVariables.description: AccuLynx company GUID. Only needed for web-API tools.
